cu-lone-star.title: Flag of Cuba (Lone Star Flag)

colors.note: The three departments of Cuba at the time of independence.
The triangle; the blood shed for independence.

desc: - The Cuban flag (designed 1850 by Teurbe Tolón) features five blue-white alternating stripes and a red triangle with a white star — used in the independence movement and kept as the national flag
trivia:
- The Lone Star flag was used during Cuba's independence wars
- Represented the hope for Cuban sovereignty
- Later adopted as the national symbol of the republic
